dedupe_keys.name: building energy estimation using machine learning barcelona use case

description: The FAIRiCUBE Barcelona machine-learning dataset supplies building-level energy-demand estimates in a CSV file. Published in July 2025 by Mohamed-Bachir Belaid and Babak Ebrahimi, it uses XGBoost with building height, construction year and shared-wall area as predictors. Access is free under CC BY 4.0. The city-scale estimates can support building-stock energy simulations and comparisons between statistical and heuristic demand methods. They are derived outputs, with the underlying observation year, energy units, training coverage and prediction uncertainty unknown from the repository summary. The corresponding EPISCOPE output is a separate resource and should be joined only after checking building identifiers. No related catalogue record explicitly covers this Barcelona prediction table. The CSV was not downloaded, and neither building completeness nor predictive accuracy was independently assessed.
